context_requirements: Intact type I interferon signaling (IFNAR1/2, JAK-STAT) for ISG induction
Functional p53 for late apoptotic and cell-cycle arrest responses
Active nucleotide salvage and de novo purine/pyrimidine synthesis pathways for IMPDH/ADA/ADK/NT5C2 inhibition to cause metabolic stress
Proliferative capacity to reveal antiproliferative effects
falsifiers: No induction of canonical interferon-stimulated genes (e.g., STAT1, PLSCR1, MX1, OAS1) at 6 or 24 h in any responsive line
No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h despite target engagement
Lack of p53 target gene induction (CDKN1A, GADD45A) in TP53-wild-type lines
No difference in response between cell lines with intact versus defective interferon signaling

evidence.supports: Interferons induce antiviral effector proteins (PKR, OAS, RNase L, Mx) and ISGs, providing a transcriptional signature for antiviral mechanisms.
Mitochondrial DNA stress engages cGAS-STING-IRF3 signaling to elevate interferon-stimulated gene expression and confer viral resistance.
IFN-alpha/beta signaling induces p53 transcription and boosts p53 responses, linking antiviral defense to p53 activation and apoptosis.
